notes:
Background: mid-size trading + risk analytics platform. Interested in Redwood Private (VPC) for regulated EU/US customers. Primary IdP: Okta. Key asks: SSO (SAML 2.0), SCIM provisioning of groups/roles, and fine-grained RBAC surfaced in Redwood Console/control plane. Also strict data residency for EU customers and audit logging for inference events.

POC ask: 2-week private VPC POC via our AWS account: - synthetic chat load for trader-assistant (p95 token latency target <200ms) - embeddings pipeline for KYC doc search (batch throughput 200-400/s) - reranking integration with existing search stack.

Security: they require encrypted SAML assertions, SCIM v2 SCIM push for new users + group sync, and RBAC to map Okta groups to Redwood roles (admin, infra, app-readonly). Must show audit trail for model/version used per request (token-level metadata preferred). KMS: require HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS / CloudHSM or Azure Key Vault HSM) with customer-managed keys for secrets & model cache encryption. Data retention: logs/audit retained 7y for compliance; raw PII must not leave EU when EU tenant flagged.

Commercial: moderate-high cost sensitivity; leaning to reserved capacity once POC validates latency and KMS flows. Quote requested for dedicated pool + private control plane.

Quotes from call: "We can't risk PII leaving EU borders"; "Need SCIM to automate provisioning for 200+ engineers"; "RBAC in console is non-negotiable for our change control audits."

Latency SLOs: p95 <200ms for interactive chat; embedding throughput 200-400 req/s. Model preference: Redwood-verified open models, quantized variants for cost; require routing fallback to smaller models during burst. Security: SAML 2.0 SSO (Okta), SCIM v2 provisioning, RBAC role mapping in control plane, KMS/HSM integration for data-at-rest keys, audit logging with 7y retention, EU data residency for EU customers. Compliance: SOC2 + ISO27001 evidence requested. POC success criteria: RBAC/SCIM working end-to-end, KMS key wrap verified, latency and throughput targets met, network peering completed.
